## Test specifications

| Test spec | Stimulus | Expected |
|---|---|---|
| ADV-UART-001.T1 | Build the board and observe the public UART binding of this enabled child. | The child is bound to exactly the parent controller independently decoded from the DTB. |
| ADV-UART-002.T1 | Build the board and collect all public UART child bindings for this controller. | Their number equals the enabled child nodes independently decoded from the DTB (0 or 1). |
| ADV-UART-003.T1 | Configure 8N1 and 7E2 at a known clock and baud rate; transmit one character from an idle line. | Completion clock = start + ceil((1 + data + parity + stop) x clock / baud); 8N1 at 1 MHz / 100 kbaud = 100 clocks, 7E2 = 110 clocks. |
| ADV-UART-004.T1 | Send two characters toward the child, the second requested before the first completes. | The child receives both in order; the second completes one character time after the first. |
| ADV-UART-005.T1 | Send characters toward the child and from the child over the same interval. | Each direction completes at its own character times and in its own order. |
| ADV-UART-006.T1 | Build the board and observe the public DMA resolution for this controller. | One resolution per dmas tuple, in dmas order, each paired with the dma-names entry at the same index. |
